field_text_formatted.value: Druxt 0.25.2 renders Drupal Canvas pages in Nuxt, and you can try it in this post without installing anything. Press Run and a Nuxt 2 site boots in your browser. It reads a recording of a Drupal CMS site's API, so no Drupal is running behind it.
